lines.trans: This wall is our main historical monument.
It remained from an ancient monastery.
A great chronicle was written here.
Every student must remember history.
What are you doing here, citizen?
I am going to demolish this old wall.
How can you destroy history?
We will build a big shopping center here.
This is our national heritage!
I have official permission for demolition.
Address all your questions to the mayor's office!
This is true arbitrariness by city authorities!
The city mayor is destroying our monuments!
Step aside away from the equipment!

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: идти во власть = go into government

examples.trans: People need to go into government themselves.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.note: neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.
He is the chairman of the city court.
We walked in the city park.

meanings.note: also an official way for police to address a man: 'Гражданин Аникеев'

examples.trans: Citizen Anikeev, you are under arrest.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.trans: The monastery is our ancient history.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it
about history: историческое наследие = historical heritage

examples.trans: This is the historic centre of the town.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know

examples.text: Здесь был утрачен древний оригинал летописи.
examples.trans: Here the ancient original of the chronicle was lost.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: He is the mayor of the town.

meanings.note: the building and the people who work there

examples.trans: He works at the town hall.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: ничего не осталось = there's nothing left

отойти.gloss: to step back, to move away

meanings.en: to step aside, to move back

examples.trans: He stepped over to the window.

собираться.gloss: to intend, to be about to; to gather

meanings.en: to intend, to plan, to be going to

examples.trans: The picture is on the wall.

meanings.note: с другой стороны = on the other hand

examples.trans: On the other hand, it's interesting.

points at something: это моё = that's mine
